title: Measurement: the compatibility key is computed from the request the canary actually made, only an approved and matching pass is recorded, and no carried or mismatched record is reused
summary: TSK-0042, toward ACC-0060 and ACC-0062 and for TSK-0037's launch check, as COMPONENT PROOF ONLY. The implementation is commit 9f1d427, and the sha256 of each file is in the facts. Neither the setup command nor bin/start-kiln.mjs calls these functions yet. THE KEY. lib/compatibility-record.mjs computes all eight determinants from current runtime inputs, never from the stored record: the selection, the model as Pi resolves it, the pinned Pi version, and the EFFECTIVE base URL. Determinant 7 carries the thinking value Pi sends: the model's mapping where it has one, null where it marks the level unsupported, the level itself otherwise, and none for a model that does not reason. Determinant 8 digests the canary protocol as handed to Pi (tool name, description, schema, system prompt, request template with a placeholder challenge, token ceiling, success-predicate version). The package capability signature is not in the key (DEC-0033). R9, THE EFFECTIVE ENDPOINT. Pi can replace a model's baseUrl with one its authentication supplies at request time. resolveEffectiveBaseUrl asks Pi's own authentication resolution with fetch refused; a resolution that would need the network leaves the endpoint unestablished, and then there is no key: setup sends no canary and reports not ready, and launch refuses record reuse (compatibility-uncacheable). R8, THE REQUEST THE CANARY MADE. The canary child resolves its own model from its isolated agent directory, so it reports a bounded projection: the four key fields it computes from its own resolved model and effective endpoint (API type, endpoint identity and source, classified request profile), or a key refusal, and the scheme, host, port and path of each request it sent, observed at fetch. No URL, query, header, credential or unbounded configuration value is reported. proofProblem accepts a pass as proof of a key only when those fields equal the key's, at least one request was observed, and every request lies under the key's endpoint on a path-segment boundary. THE RECORD. Only a passed canary that proves its key is written, and reading and writing both go through the consent record's gate: the ignore block and Git's answer about the record's actual path. A tracked, committed, unignored or unverifiable record is untrusted and never reused (D20). SETUP'S CHECK. lib/live-model-check.mjs reuses a trusted record matching every determinant without asking; otherwise it asks with the section 6.4 prompt naming the provider, the exact model and the possible charge. A run that cannot ask needs --live-model-check approve. deny or a no is a choice: not ready, no request, nothing recorded. A pass that cannot be recorded proves this run only and is reported as awaiting a per-run check, not ready (D21). LAUNCH. lib/launch-checks.mjs's zeroCostPreflight (checks 1 to 6) now also establishes the effective endpoint, and checkLaunch computes the key itself. A different-model one-run override never uses the record, even one matching it, and takes its own approved live check for that run (D17). The project's own selection is proved by a trusted matching record, or refuses to setup (D18); where its record cannot be trusted, each run needs its own check. The canary runner is supplied by the caller (D19). RESULTS. (1) ACC-0060: the prompt names the provider display name, the exact model ID and that the provider may charge, and the canary runs only after the answer. Five declines (false, null, a string, deny, deny with an ask) are choices with no request and no record. A run that cannot ask refuses naming the model and --live-model-check approve; approve runs without asking; with a matching record no flag is needed. (2) ACC-0062: a matching record is reused with nothing asked or sent; a change of provider, model, thinking level, Pi version, API type, endpoint, request profile or canary digest each reopens approval, and declining leaves the record byte-identical. (3) The digest changes with each of its seven parts, ignores key order, and holds exactly those parts. (4) A failed canary, and a runner returning no pass, record nothing and leave an existing record byte-identical. (5) A query-routed endpoint is not checked at all until an identity is declared; with one, the record is keyed declared and holds no query. (6) R9: an unestablishable endpoint sends no canary and, at launch, refuses with no network attempt observed; authentication that supplies a base URL makes that the keyed endpoint, and at launch makes a record taken at the catalogue endpoint mismatch on endpointIdentity. (7) R8: another resolved API type or request profile, a request elsewhere, a request on a sibling path, no observed request and a key refusal in the child each fail the pass in setup and at launch, and nothing is recorded. End to end with the real canary, a child handed a model configuration that does not reason, while the host's does, fails with canary-inputs-differ on effectiveRequestProfile. (8) D20: a force-added record committed and cloned is untrusted in the clone; setup asks again, and launch refuses without a per-run check and passes with one. (9) D21: tracked, unverifiable and unignored locations each leave a pass unrecorded and report awaiting a per-run check, not ready. (10) D17: a stored record matching the override model does not stand in for the override's own approved check. (11) END TO END: the zero-cost preflight, the approved live check with the real canary against a loopback endpoint, then checkLaunch: setup records under the computed key and launch accepts that record with no further request. LIMITS. No billable provider was called; every canary used a loopback endpoint through Pi's openai-completions client. Only fetch-based provider clients are observable; a client that does not use fetch leaves no observed request, which fails the proof rather than passing it. The effective endpoint is established by refusing fetch; a resolution that reached the network another way would not be refused. Wiring into setup (TSK-0060) and into bin/start-kiln.mjs (TSK-0037) is not done, so the criteria are not evaluated. MUTATIONS, RUN LOCALLY ON WINDOWS. Thirty-nine mutations were run across the key, digest, effective endpoint, proof, record gate, setup check, launch and child; thirty-seven failed the tests. Two are equivalent: allowing a failed canary to be recorded is still refused by the record schema, and accepting a runner that returns no pass at launch is still refused by the proof check. Each was restored byte-identical by sha256. CI. GitHub Actions run 35750449049 at c249915, which adds only plan files to 9f1d427, attempt 1 with no job re-run, passed in all four cells, and all 16 live-model-check, 16 launch-check and 8 live-canary tests passed in every cell. The live compatibility tier ran in the ubuntu Node 24 cell and passed 6 of 6.
